name: Veterinary API
description:
Requests for the local demo REST server (`examples/servers/demo-servers.mjs`).

## Getting started

1. Start the demo servers: `node examples/servers/demo-servers.mjs`.
2. Select the **Development** environment.
3. Run **Authentication → Get access token** first. Its test script saves `accessToken`, which the other requests use through the collection's bearer auth.

The **Cookie session** folder shows cookie-based login instead of tokens. **Get patient** has saved examples, so the collection's **Mock** tab can serve it without the demo server.

items.name: Get access token
items.testScript:
pm.test('Status code is 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.environment.set('accessToken', pm.response.json().access_token);

items.name: List patients
Get patient
items.description:
Returns one patient by id.

| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | The patient exists |
| `401` | No or wrong bearer token |
| `404` | No patient with that id |

items.name: Log in (sets a cookie)
items.description: Logs in with a username and password. The server answers `303 See Other` with a `vet_session` cookie and redirects to **Who am I**. TestPion keeps the cookie in the workspace cookie jar and sends it with the next requests.
items.testScript:
pm.test('Redirected to the profile', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Session cookie is in the jar', () => pm.expect(pm.cookies.has('vet_session')).to.be.true);

items.name: Who am I (uses the cookie)
items.testScript:
pm.test('Logged in by cookie', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().user).to.equal('vet'));
pm.cookies.jar().get(pm.request.url.toString(), 'clinic', (err, clinic) => pm.test('Clinic cookie', () => pm.expect(clinic).to.equal('north')));
